turns.text: Hi, can you give me the delivery address for order SC-3551? The order belongs to my brother, not to me.

Hi! I'm sorry, but I can't share any details about an order, including its address, until I've verified it. To do that I need the order number and the email the order was placed with. Since the order is your brother's, I can't share its details with you without that email. He can contact us himself, or you can give me the email on the order if you have it.
If you need an email, mine is jamie.holt@example.com. I only want his address.

I couldn't match that order number and email, so I can't share anything about the order. Please check both. The email must be the one the order was placed with. If the order is your brother's, that is probably his email, not yours.

error.message: No order matches that order number and email. Ask the customer to check both.
